plan.title: Donation Overview
plan.subtitle: Monthly trends, top cities, payment modes, and donor frequency

panels.title: Monthly donation trend
panels.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST("Date" AS DATE)) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) SELECT month, total FROM monthly

panels.title: Donations by city
panels.sql: SELECT "City", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Donations by payment mode
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 repeat donors
panels.sql: WITH donor_counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS freq FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY freq DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT "Donor", freq FROM donor_counts

plan.narrative:

Geographically, the city contributing the highest amount is {{p6.total}} (from the top city panel), followed by others. The most popular payment method for the largest sum is {{p7.total}} (from the top mode panel).
